question: Should the native SDK ship a whitespace/syntax-minified aster-core.js? (design §5.7)
rule: Adopt if raw size drops at least 30% or engine-creation-to-first-scene p50 drops at least 10%.
minifier: esbuild 0.28.2 --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax (identifiers kept for bridge function names)

startup.host: macOS 26.7.2 arm64, JavaScriptCore, release Swift build

reason: The source bundle is already dense, so minification removes only 7.8% of bytes and about 2% of startup time on JavaScriptCore; both are far below the adoption rule. Shipping the readable bundle keeps JS stack traces and audits simple.
limits: QuickJS/Android startup was not measured for the minified bundle; the 7.8% size reduction bounds its parse benefit similarly.
